title: Preserve the stronger16-support statement as an unfinished global proof report
statement: The producer reports that an optimal allocation in the acoustically completed problem for an actual field with positive definite covariance has support on at most16 field-dependent rank-one directions, allowing limiting acoustic atoms. This is distinct from the supplied-catalogue17-atom elimination and relies on a further global dual-contact/duality/attainment argument still under development at this cut. The coordinator assessment is not a completed independent review of that argument. No universal-success, efficient discovery, bit-complexity, full-face QC or actual separation is established; one failed catalogue says nothing global.
